segment_contamination_dimensions: Portable and self-contained toilet unit buyers (construction sites, outdoor events, temporary sanitation deployments) — siblings Portable Toilets, FRP Portable Toilet, MS Portable Toilets, Sintex Portable Toilets, Bunk House Portable Toilets, Chemical Toilets attract buyers seeking standalone relocatable toilet units, not fixed washroom partition systems; any name containing 'portable', 'mobile', 'relocatable', 'temporary', 'site toilet', or 'self-contained' is blocked.

Complete modular toilet room/cabin buyers (FRP Modular Toilet, Modular Toilet, RCC Toilet, PVC Toilet siblings) — these buyers seek prefabricated full toilet room structures, not internal partition systems installed within an existing washroom; any name implying a complete toilet room or cabin structure is blocked.

Toilet Cubicles sibling (ID 42586) — this is a near-identical sibling MCAT; the name 'Toilet Cubicles' as a standalone label is blocked to avoid direct name collision, though cubicle-descriptive compound terms (e.g., 'toilet cubicle partition', 'cubicle partition system') remain valid as they describe the partition product, not the sibling category.

Mobile Toilet Van and Bio Toilet siblings attract municipal/infrastructure buyers for vehicle-mounted or bio-digester sanitation — entirely different buyer persona and use context; any name containing 'van', 'mobile unit', 'bio', or 'bio-digester' is blocked.
